projects.title: DevForge AI – AI Game Development Toolkit
projects.shortDescription: AI assistant for the Unity Editor: chat, code agent, scene and UI builders, optimizers and QA. Uses your own AI tool login (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor) – no API keys.
projects.description:
⚡ DevForge AI brings an AI development assistant, project analysis, and safe automated fixes into one Unity Editor window.

Describe what you want in plain language — a question about your code, a bug to fix, a scene to set up, or a complete feature. DevForge AI collects the relevant project context, asks the AI tool you already use, and shows every proposed change for your review before anything in your project is modified.

🔑 USE YOUR OWN AI — NO API KEYS

DevForge AI has no AI service or subscription of its own. It runs the official command-line tool of your provider with your own login:

• Claude Code (default)
• OpenAI Codex CLI
• Google Antigravity CLI (Gemini)
• Cursor CLI
• A local OpenAI-compatible model server (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio)

An account with at least one of these providers is required for AI features.

🧠 WHAT YOU CAN DO

• 💬 AI Chat with automatic project context — project information, scene, selection, Console, and project memory.
• 🏗️ Build from One Prompt — the AI creates a Development Plan covering systems, scripts, GameObjects, components, references, prefabs, and UI. After approval, agents implement it step by step, compile and verify, then provide a final report.
• 💻 Code Agent — plan → diff review → apply → compile check → AI error fixing, with rollback support.
• 🎬 Scene, GameObject, Prefab, UI & Animation Assistants — turn descriptions into reviewed editor operations with a single Undo step.
• 🤖 Agent Orchestrator — coordinate multi-step feature implementation.
• 🔍 Project Analyzers & Fixers — detect and fix missing scripts, lighting, textures, audio, models, materials, prefabs, UI, platform settings, and build settings.
• 🚀 Optimization Tools — performance, mobile, WebGL, graphics, memory, and build-size optimization.
• 🧪 Testing & QA — Console Fixer, Build Tools, Testing, and one-click Verify Project.
• 📖 Documentation Generator — generate documentation for game systems, API references, README files, and project architecture.

🛡️ SAFE BY DESIGN

• 👁️ Read-Only AI — the AI can read your project, if you allow it, but cannot directly write files or run commands.
• 🔎 Review Before Apply — every proposed change is shown first as a diff or operation list and is applied only after you confirm.
• 💾 Backups & Rollback — files, assets, and settings are backed up; scene edits support Unity Undo and one-click rollback.
• 📁 Controlled Writes — writes only inside Assets/. Likely secrets are removed from the context before sending.
• 🚫 No Telemetry — there is no DevForge server or telemetry. Data goes only to the AI provider you choose, and only after you accept the data notice.

👥 WHO IT'S FOR

• 🎮 Indie Developers & Solo Creators — use an AI assistant directly inside Unity without constantly switching between tools.
• 🏢 Small Studios & Teams — prototype faster with changes that can be reviewed and undone.
• 👨‍💻 Programmers — generate, fix, and refactor C#, resolve compile errors, and document project APIs.
• 🎨 Game & Level Designers — create GameObjects, scenes, and UI from descriptions, review the proposed operations, then apply them.
• 🧑‍🎨 Technical Artists — shader and material checks, Built-in to URP conversion, and texture, audio, and model import fixes.
• 🎓 Students & Unity Beginners — ask questions about their own project and get errors and code explained.
• 📱 Mobile & WebGL Teams — use optimization tools, build checks, and Verify Project before release.
• 🤖 AI Tool Users — anyone already using Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Google Gemini (Antigravity), Cursor, or a local AI model.

ℹ️ Note: DevForge AI is an Editor tool. It helps you build and maintain your game; it does not add AI features to the game at runtime.

📚 DOCUMENTATION

Includes:

• 📄 Illustrated PDF guide
• 📘 In-editor Product Guide explaining every feature
• 📝 Markdown documentation — User Guide, AI Providers, Privacy, Security, Compatibility, and Known Limitations

⚙️ REQUIREMENTS

• Unity 6 (6000.0) or newer
• 🖥️ Editor-only extension
• 📦 Nothing is added to your player builds

projects.title: Nine Men’s Morris (board game)
projects.shortDescription: Experience the classic Nine Men's Morris! Form a mill, capture opponent pieces, and claim victory! 🧠🎲
projects.description:
Dive into the ultimate strategic board game, Nine Men's Morris! Also known as Navakankari, Merels, or Mills, this timeless game challenges your logic and planning skills on a beautifully crafted digital wooden board.

Key Features:

🤖 Play vs Bot: Test your strategic skills against an intelligent AI.

👥 Play vs Friend: Enjoy local multiplayer (Pass & Play) with your friends and family.

🧑‍🎨 Custom Avatars & Profiles: Choose your favorite avatar from a unique collection and set your custom player name.

⚙️ Customizable Settings: Easily toggle Sound, Music, and Vibration for a personalized experience.

🏆 Earn Rewards: Win matches to collect in-game coins and track your progress!

How to Play:

Place: Take turns placing your pieces on the empty spots of the board.

Form a Mill: Align 3 of your pieces in a straight line to create a "Mill" (highlighted in green).

Capture: Every time you form a Mill, capture one of your opponent's pieces.

Win: Reduce your opponent to 2 pieces or block all their possible moves to win the match!

changelog.notes:
v1.0.0

🚀 Initial release of Nine Men's Morris!

👥 Added local multiplayer mode (Play vs Friend).

🎨 Introduced custom avatars and player name customization.

🎵 Added sound, music, and vibration controls.

✨ Smooth wooden board UI and completely offline gameplay.

projects.title: Corona Fight Game
projects.shortDescription: Join the Corona Warriors! 🐒 Defeat virus monsters 🦠, collect coins 🪙, and save the world in this fun and action-packed 2D platformer game! 🌍✨

Start your journey as the agile Monkey Warrior armed with a staff, or collect coins to unlock the powerful gun-wielding Hero 🐒🔫.   Jump, run, and fight your way through beautifully designed 2D platformer levels 🏃‍♂️💨. Explore 4 exciting and unique worlds: lush Mountains, dark Underground caves, floating Sky islands, and freezing Winter landscapes ⛰️🌌❄️.   ✨ Game Features:🎮 Classic Platforming: Enjoy smooth 2D run-and-jump gameplay with easy controls (Left, Right, Jump, and Attack).   🌍 4 Exciting Worlds: Conquer 10 challenging levels in each world to progress further.   🦸‍♂️ Character Selection: Play as the Monkey Warrior or collect 2,000 coins to unlock the new Hero.   🪙 Power-ups & Collectibles: Collect Coins 🪙, Extra Lives ❤️, Bullets 🔫, and Health/Sanitizer potions 🧴 as you cross levels.   🎵 Family Friendly Fun: Features colorful graphics, relaxing background music, and a positive message of defeating viruses.
